label: Whatever causes another's being gives it being whenever anything gives it being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (concurrence of causes of being): in every history of the model, if c, distinct from x, causes x's being (CausesIn c x esse, the tenseless CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3) and something gives x being at moment t (GivesAt v g x t, definition 158301bc, STRICT esse-giving reading), then c gives x being at t. It is the only premise of the concurrent-actualization derivation linking the tenseless CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 to time-indexed giving, so it carries the cross-term passage CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 -> CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 (disambiguation 88a8fba7) on that route; the weak sustaining reading is its derived conclusion. A per se ordering of the givers of a thing's being: a cause of x's being is acting on x whenever any giver of x's being is. It supplies the step from 'some giver at each moment' to 'this cause at each moment' (the quantifier swap and the identification). It constrains only moments at which something gives x being, so the extrinsic existential-inertia interpretation satisfies it (Control part 1). Rival: persistence-power existential inertia (a thing gives itself being after its originating cause ceases; Control part 2) satisfies the weak concurrent actualization and rejects this premise; the reply on file is Feser 2021's circularity argument (a power depends on its substance, so the substance cannot depend on that power without circularity; paragraphs beginning 'Now, an objection', 'I find this' and 'Another problem'), a provisional analyst judgment in attempt 05bc2722, section (b5). Lead, not an established counterexample to the esse case: in illumination a room lit by a lamp can then be lit by daylight with the lamp off (a relay of sources, Control part 3 is the typed shape); whether causes of being admit such a relay is open; the immensity route needs this premise only for a cause of the being of everything else, and a restriction to such causes would avoid the relay lead (not formalized).
